jurisdiction_name: NO COLLEGE HILL WARD 2 (NORTH COLLEGE HILL City)
narrative: No College Hill Ward 2 (City of North College Hill) has 1,095 registered voters, with 68.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 5.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 25.4%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 19.6 percentage points.
